hypothesis: The production Gemini reader identity avoids the catastrophic repetition observed in PaddleOCR-VL and Kimi-VL on most AncientDoc pages, and the adjudicator's route_recommendation identifies every page whose transcription CER is catastrophic (>= 1.0) without rejecting most healthy pages.
decision: Adopt the Gemini production reader identity as the AncientDoc full-page baseline: it beats PaddleOCR-VL on 24 of 28 pages with no repetition events. Keep the deterministic count gate: it caught the one detector failure. Treat the agentic adjudicator as a validated failure detector but an over-conservative router: it caught all three catastrophic pages and correctly diagnosed which component failed per page, but routed four healthy pages to column_mode, failing the declared precision gate. Next: implement bounded column-mode reading for flagged pages and tighten the adjudicator with explicit per-column count anchors.

geometry_results.count_gate_finding: The one deterministic flag (ratio 15.54) is a true detector failure: RF-DETR found 50 boxes on a dense two-folio spread of about 777 characters, missing the entire left folio. The transcription on that page is faithful; the detector, not the reader, is the failing component.
geometry_results.column_rule: sorted x-center gap splitting at 0.45 of median box width

adjudicator_results.healthy_precision_gate: failed: 4 healthy pages routed away, gate allowed 2
grounded_findings: Caught specific misreadings on the Chu Ci page: 逐 for 遂, 荀 for 苟, omitted 以.
Diagnosed the detector failure on the 藝文類聚 spread: boxes missing_text, transcription faithful, accept_full_page.
Identified punctuation circles and margin fold labels boxed as characters on the 湖海集 page.
Identified double-row interlinear commentary as the structural cause of line-to-column mismatch on commentary-heavy pages.

evidence.normalization: Unicode NFC and CRLF or bare CR to LF; no stripping; no-space variant reported separately
evidence.scorer: rapidfuzz 3.14.3 Levenshtein distance, installed for scoring and removed afterward

limitations: Development evidence on 28 cases; no qualification suite, no promotion.
Gold on commentary-heavy pages covers only the primary text, so part of the high CER on the three catastrophic pages is transcribed-but-unscored interlinear commentary, not pure misreading.
The adjudicator saw a 1600-pixel overlay JPEG, not full-resolution boxes.
Single run per page; no variance estimate.
next_permitted_action: Implement bounded column-mode reading: crop flagged pages into detector-derived columns, transcribe each crop with a count-anchored token ceiling using the same frozen reader identity, assemble right-to-left, and compare paired CER against these full-page transcriptions before touching any production record.
